_doc: Every public class, method and free function of each binding, by binding, under one canonical name (snake_case; spelt camelCase in TS). A null name must be explained in `why`: 'ecosystem: ...' for a deliberate difference, 'gap: ...' for one still to fix ('gap: unclassified' awaits a decision). A class a binding lacks is null, explained once in the class's `why`. tests/dual-backend/bindingParity.test.ts (WASM, NAPI) and crates/alizarin-python/tests/test_binding_parity.py check each binding exports exactly what is listed here, so anything added to one binding only fails until it is listed. Rebuild with scripts/guards/binding_manifest.py.
